reason: My nights get filled by my PR guys and the WhatsApp lists, not by an app. Free listing I might let them load my flyers, but I'm not paying anyone until I see people actually using it.
objection: You're a startup, will you still be around in six months? And who is actually opening this app on a Saturday instead of just asking a PR or checking Instagram?
would_change_my_mind: Seeing the app already past 2,000 active users in my city, with other clubs I know on it and proof that people on it actually showed up at their doors.
